name: Poke Salad Bar - Large Bowl White Rice and Salad, Spicy Ahi Tuna, Scallop, Salmon x2, Edamame, Green Onion, Wasabi, Crispy Onion, Crabmeat, Cucumbers, Jalapeno, Seaweed, Eel Sauce, Wasabi Mayo 1 bowl (about 25 oz)
notes: Poke Salad Bar (Pasadena) publishes no nutrition, so this is an estimate. Four proteins make the large bowl; each scoop is about 2 oz (57 g) of fish. The base is the menu's half and half: 1 cup cooked white rice (4.3 g protein, 44.5 g carbohydrate, 0.4 g fat, from the Rice - White 1 cup cooked entry) and about 1 1/2 cups shredded romaine (71 g) for the salad half. Proteins: salmon x2 (2 oz raw Atlantic farmed each: 11.6 g protein, 7.6 g fat), spicy ahi (1.5 oz raw yellowfin plus 1 tbsp mayonnaise standing in for the spicy mayo: 10.4 g protein, 10.2 g fat), and scallop (2 oz raw: 6.9 g protein, 1.8 g carbohydrate, 0.3 g fat). Mix-ins: crabmeat counted as 2 oz imitation crab (4.3 g protein, 8.5 g carbohydrate, 0.3 g fat), cucumber 1/4 cup (30 g), jalapeno about 15 g, and seaweed salad 1.5 oz. Tops: edamame 1/4 cup (4.7 g protein, 3.5 g carbohydrate, 2.1 g fat), green onion 2 tbsp (12 g), wasabi 1 tsp (5 g of raw wasabi root as a stand-in for the paste), and French's crispy fried onions 2 tbsp (3.5 g fat, 3 g carbohydrate). Sauces: Kikkoman Unagi Sushi Sauce 1.5 tbsp (15 g carbohydrate, 12 g added sugar, 1,065 mg sodium; the label lists protein as under 1 g per tablespoon, counted here as 0) and wasabi mayo 1.5 tbsp counted as regular mayonnaise (15 g fat). Total about 1,007 kcal (55.7 g protein, 87.4 g carbohydrate, 48.3 g fat) and about 25 oz (714 g). Sodium is about 2,320 mg, of which about 1,065 mg is the eel sauce. Saturated, monounsaturated, and polyunsaturated fat sum to 41.8 g; the fried onions (2 g) and seaweed salad (0.8 g) publish no unsaturated split, and part of the salmon fat is outside USDA's fatty-acid classes. Added sugar is the eel sauce's 12 g. Seaweed salad has 2.6 g total sugar and the imitation crab about 3.5 g total sugar; those labels do not split added sugar, so those amounts stay out of added sugar. Sriracha in the spicy tuna is inside the mayonnaise figure. Seamless and MenuPages list the large bowl as 4 proteins from ahi tuna, spicy tuna, salmon, scallops, albacore, octopus, or shrimp, and half and half as rice and salad. A Sirved review lists crabmeat, cucumber, jalapeno, and seaweed as mix-ins, and edamame, green onion, wasabi, and crunchy onion as tops, with sweet eel and wasabi mayo among the sauces. Fish, romaine, scallion, jalapeno, wasabi root, and imitation crab are USDA SR Legacy (FDC 175167, 175159, 174220, 169247, 170005, 168576, 168583, 174203). Rice, edamame, cucumber, and mayonnaise use the amounts already in this file. Crispy onions are French's Original, 2 Tbsp (7 g), USDA branded FDC 2601406. Seaweed salad is the Fujisan Handcrafted Sushi 100 g label scaled to 43 g. Eel sauce, crispy onions, and seaweed salad contribute only the nutrients on those labels. Vitamin K is 129 mcg phylloquinone.
